name: 会話内で共有する動画リンク
prompt:
Correct image 1. Its content is close, but the card and text are too small and the whole card sits much too low. Use image 3's compact geometry. Output one exact ratio canvas 390x326. Place the actual card at X64 Y8, width310, height304. Card must occupy 79.5 percent of canvas width and 93 percent of canvas height; only 64 px left margin,16 px right margin,8 px top and14 px bottom. The thin forest left stripe at64,8 is3x304; face x68,y8,width306,height304. Do not center a smaller card inside the white canvas. Do not add inset margins above content.

Preserve the attached original video preview art. The image is x80 y112 exactly, w282 h186 (aspect1.516); match image2's YouTube card scene/panel structure closely, including vertical central short, dark playback strip, round dark play overlay, white triangle, red annotations and car/phone imagery. The previous thumbnail was too wide and too small. Keep the exact area and image proportions.

Use these absolute logical positions on the 390x326 canvas:
x80,y18 provider 動画の共有, Meiryo Regular12/16 gray.
x80,y44 title 地域の活動を伝える工夫, Meiryo Bold14/24 forest.
x80,y74 category 発信のアイデア・交流・地域の活動, Meiryo Regular12/16 forest.
No line breaks, no enlarged typography, tracking0. These text sizes are small compared with the canvas; maintain real compact UI scale. Thumbnail x80,y112,w282,h186. Preserve negative white canvas space exactly.

Face #F4F4F5 or light neutral, corner radius8, stripe and title/category forest #057857; native adaptation. Exact Japanese spelling/punctuation. Provider #6E6E6E. Nothing else. The previous whole-card content was vertically offset: move the card top from ~y39 to y8 and move all text to its listed coordinates. Correct all dimensions explicitly. Avoid the broad extra card padding, and preserve first reference's actual image as much as feasible.
reviewNotes: 2回目でサムネイル比率と幅を改善し、動画場面と全日本語を維持。カードはなお上端y38程度からでnative指定y8より低く、全高約256 vs304、文字もY方向に低い。thumbnail pixel-exactness not claimed. 2回上限のため残差ありで保留。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
